get_ocp_models: create a python module that uses the OCP API Client to fetch and print the list of supported models
get_ocp_bulks: create a python module that uses the OCP API Client to fetch and print the list of supported bulk materials
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: create a python module that submits adsorbate slab relaxation jobs to the OCP API using a specified model
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results: create a python module that fetches relaxation results for a given system ID from the OCP API
get_adsorbate_slab_configs: create a python module that fetches adsorbate binding site configurations for a given slab from the OCP API
